what: Product-like items are scattered at random positions inside the stage so they never overlap (item width + gap box, up to 100 redraws, 40px inside the edges), and clicking an empty spot scatters them again — positions move over .7s ease-out. At first they appear one by one from 1s later at .05s intervals, each over 1s power2.out. A ‹Click to shuffle› label attached 16px to the right of the cursor trails late with left .5s and top .4s power3.out, disappears in .3s over an item and returns in .7s when the cursor leaves it. On narrow screens (under 768) nothing is scattered and items stay in the grid of the layout in use.

options.min: Panel width where scattering starts (px), default 768
options.gap: Minimum gap between items (px), default .556% of board width
options.tries: Number of non-overlapping position draws, default 100
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Items to scatter — width is set by the consumer css (measured as a square box)
options.[data-fx-part=label]: (Optional) Hint text that follows the cursor
options.wait: If ready, it does not appear until the fx:ready event arrives on the panel — so it shows only after the loader finishes
